source.label: Wizards Gen Con 2012 coverage, "10:30 p.m. - Vintage Championships Top 8 Decklists"

notes.text: Seeds from the Top 8 bracket; finishes from the deck captions (Champion, Finalist, Semifinalist, Quarterfinalist). 186 players, eight Swiss rounds and the Top 8 all on Friday 17 August.

Wizards prints no archetype names; archetypes are the names on the lhc Deckbox sets. mtgtop8 names them differently (e.g. Lanigra "Snapcaster Control", Gouthro "Salvagers Combo", the Workshop decks "MUD").
Copied as Wizards printed it (3 Phyrexian Metamorph, as mtgtop8). The Deckbox copy has 4, for 61 cards.
Copied as Wizards printed it (3 Mishra's Factory, 4 Mishra's Workshop, as mtgtop8). The Deckbox copy has 4 Factory and 3 Workshop. The Top 8 announcement spells him "Scheffenaker".
His deck caption omits "Quarterfinalist"; he was the 2 seed and lost to the 7 seed, Blaine Christiansen, who reached the final.
